calibration.rationale: CPU selection from measured parameter-gradient Grams only. Geometry uses shape=1 and cross-batch median raw-norm ratios for logsigma:relative-centroid:shape approximately 2:1:1; centroid uses eligible multi-part batches only. The common multiplier uses each batch's actual Gram composite, targeting geometry/Head=1 for IA or J/density=0.5 for IB. IB targets occupancy-BCE/density=1 and leaves Dice disabled. These are conservative starting policies, not demonstrated optimal weights or evidence of training benefit.

record.rationale: Allow a controlled frozen-Head IB rendering experiment: clean IA1 completed400 updates with exact frozen SHA; relative to its same fixed start, matched216 Head IoU .252255->.449461, x+y logsigma .900745->.426860, relative centroid .637929->.194315, shape .517884->.383418; all9 authors have higher mean IoU and lower mean scale. Late snapshots show a plateau without two consecutive joint scale/occupancy deteriorations. Thirteen fixed glyph strips across9 authors (including required5) were inspected: nonempty coarse structure is present, but thick/merged parts remain. This is an experimental technical gate, not a claim of reliable final structure, superiority to Run B Fix, independent generalization or human acceptance.
record.selection_policy: bounded endpoint; all snapshots retained, no best-of-val winner claim
